tooltip.trashCancel: Stop the timed removal. The item stays in the trash.
tooltip.trashPurge: Delete this item for good. Available after the restore window, and never for a file another DJ app still uses.
tooltip.trashRestore: Put this item back. Nothing is written until you confirm.
tooltip.reviewRestore: Review what restoring this snapshot would change.
tooltip.runSetup: Run setup to find music folders.
tooltip.saveVersions: Save version links and a Versions of crate. Quit Serato first. Nothing changes when the family is already saved.
tooltip.saveSuggestion: Save a two-way link to {name}. Serato is not changed until you update the crate.
tooltip.scanFull: Decode every file in the selected crate. Choose a crate first. This can take minutes. Nothing is written.
tooltip.scanQuick: Read the start of each audio file. Empty files and the wrong format show up here. Nothing is written.
tooltip.search: Search tracks by title or artist. Use the field menu to search comments, grouping, or composer. Filter with bpm:120-128, bpm:124~3, bpm:none, key:8A, key:none, mix:8A, missing:yes, nokeybpm:yes, cues:none, comments:, grouping:, or composer:. Ctrl/Cmd+F or /. Esc clears the search.
tooltip.searchField: Search one field. All fields is title, artist, album, genre, key, and file. Comments, grouping, and composer need this menu or comments:, grouping:, composer:.
tooltip.seek: Move through the track. Left arrow goes back 5 seconds. Right arrow goes forward 5 seconds. Shift with an arrow jumps 30 seconds.
tooltip.selectFile: Select {name} for rename, move, or delete.
tooltip.selectFilePath: Select {name} at {path} for rename, move, or delete.
tooltip.session: Show the tracks played in the session {name}.
tooltip.shortcuts: Keyboard shortcuts for this screen. ? opens this list.
tooltip.shortcutsChange: Press a new key for this action. Esc cancels.
tooltip.shortcutsFilter: Filter the shortcut list by action or key.
tooltip.shortcutsReset: Put this shortcut back to the Serato DJ Pro default.
tooltip.shortcutsResetAll: Put every shortcut back to the Serato DJ Pro default.
tooltip.showSearchCopies: Show the fields that were compared.
tooltip.smartRules: Edit the smart crate rules. Nothing is saved until you press Save rules.
tooltip.snapshotConfirm: Restore this snapshot. A new snapshot is saved first.
tooltip.snapshotsList: Snapshot list. Up arrow and Down arrow move between rows. Enter reviews the snapshot.
tooltip.snapshotsTake: Save a backup of the library.
tooltip.snapshotsUndo: Review undoing the last outside change.
tooltip.sortAdded: Sort crates by the date they were added.
tooltip.sortDateAdded: Sort tracks by the date they were added.
tooltip.sortEnergy: Sort tracks by energy. Uses Grouping Energy N (1 to 10) when set, otherwise the star rating (1 to 5).
tooltip.sortLastPlayed: Sort tracks by the last time they were played.
tooltip.sortOrder: Sort crates in the saved order.
tooltip.sortPlayed: Sort history by whether the track was played.
tooltip.sortStart: Sort history by the time it started.
tooltip.space: Choose Library, Video, Apple Music, or Prepare.
tooltip.splitter: Drag to resize the track list. Double-click to put it back. Arrow keys resize it.
tooltip.statsCsv: Download this report as a spreadsheet. Read-only.
tooltip.statsFrom: First day of a custom period.
tooltip.statsIdleCrate: Preview a crate of tracks not played in this many days, then confirm. Serato must be quit.
tooltip.statsIdleDays: A track not played for this many days is listed. Default 365.
tooltip.statsPeriod: Limit most-played counts to this period. Idle tracks use Idle days, not this period.
tooltip.statsRefresh: Load play stats for this period.
tooltip.statsTo: Last day of a custom period.
tooltip.tagsApply: Write this spelling on every track in the group. Quit Serato first. Check Write to files too for MP3 and M4A.
tooltip.tagsApplyMappings: Write saved genre and artist spellings on tracks that still use another form. Quit Serato first. Check Write to files too for MP3 and M4A.
tooltip.tagsApplyTitles: Write the cleaned titles. Quit Serato first. Check Write to files too for MP3 and M4A.
tooltip.tagsArtist: Show artist names that are the same words written different ways.
tooltip.tagsGenre: Show genres that are the same words written different ways.
tooltip.tagsTitles: Show titles that would change after stripping numbers, URLs, Original Mix, and feat., and title-casing ALL CAPS or all lowercase.
tooltip.tagsGroup: Open or close this spelling group.
tooltip.tagsPreview: Show which tracks would change before writing the library.
tooltip.tagsSpelling: Choose this spelling for every track in the group.
tooltip.tagsWriteFiles: Also write ID3 and MP4 tags on those tracks. Serato markers stay. FLAC is skipped.
tooltip.telemetry: Turn anonymous stats and crash reports on or off.
tooltip.trackColor: Choose a color for this track.
tooltip.trackList: Track list. Up arrow and Down arrow move between rows. Enter opens the row. Space plays or pauses.
tooltip.trackRating: Choose a rating for this track.
tooltip.updateDismiss: Hide this until the app opens again.
tooltip.updateDownload: Open this release's page on GitHub in your browser.
tooltip.updatePrereleases: Also tell you about beta versions and release candidates.
tooltip.updateRelated: Create or refresh the Related crate in Serato. Serato has to be quit.
tooltip.updateSkip: Don't tell you about this version again.
tooltip.untrustedVolumes: Volume names that do not count as copies, comma-separated. An unplugged drive is never counted.
tooltip.updateToggle: Ask GitHub once a day whether a newer version is out.
tooltip.useInCrates: Put another track in every crate this one is in, at the same position.
tooltip.versionLink: Save this link as a version of the same recording.
tooltip.versionPlay: Prelisten this version in the player.
tooltip.viewBitrate: Flag files whose stated bitrate is much higher than the spectrum, or lossless files made from a lossy encode. Needs a crate. Saving a crate writes the library.
tooltip.viewCompare: See tracks in both crates, only in A, or only in B. Save any set as a crate.
tooltip.viewDrift: Flag tracks whose tempo wanders, or that look like live recordings. Needs a crate. Read-only.
tooltip.viewOctave: Flag tracks whose stored BPM is about half or double the rest of the crate. Needs a crate.
tooltip.drawerToggle: Hide or show the navigation drawer.
tooltip.skipToContent: Jump to the track list and skip the bar and drawer.
tooltip.driftRefresh: Run the tempo check again on the selected crate.
tooltip.octaveRefresh: Run the BPM check again on the selected crate.
tooltip.octaveFix: Double or halve the stored BPM. The beatgrid is left alone.
tooltip.viewDuplicates: Show tracks that look like copies of each other.
tooltip.viewGig: Check the library before a gig. Read-only.
tooltip.viewHealth: One-page counts of missing files, missing BPM or key, empty genre, tracks in no crate, and duplicates. Read-only.
tooltip.viewAudio: Notice a file replaced under the same name. Cues and the beatgrid may not fit. Saving a crate writes the library.
tooltip.viewLost: Fill a blank title or artist from the file. Writes the library, not the audio.
tooltip.viewEnergy: Write Energy 1–10 into a blank Grouping field. Needs a crate. Writes the library, not the audio.
tooltip.viewMissing: Show tracks whose files are missing on a connected drive. Tracks on an unplugged drive stay in crates as offline.
tooltip.viewPortable: Check a portable Serato drive before a gig. Pick a connected drive. Read-only.
tooltip.viewScan: Find audio files that are empty, the wrong format, or will not decode. Read-only.
tooltip.viewSnapshots: Open backups. Hash-checked copies of the library, crates, and cue frames. Ctrl/Cmd+5.
tooltip.viewStats: Most played tracks and artists in a period, idle tracks, and a CSV of the report.
tooltip.viewStems: Show tracks Serato has analyzed for stems. This does not separate the audio.
tooltip.viewTags: Group genre and artist spellings that mean the same thing. Writes the library, not the audio files.
tooltip.wizard.checkAgain: Look for the Serato library again.
tooltip.wizard.openLibrary: Finish setup and open the library.
tooltip.wizard.saving: Saving a safety copy of the library.

tooltip.wizard.tryAgain: Try saving the safety copy again.
tooltip.wizard.useLibrary: Use the library that was found.
tooltip.wizardCancel: Cancel setup. The library is not changed. Esc.
tooltip.wizardFolderUp: Go up to the parent folder.
tooltip.wizardFolderUse: Use this folder as the library.
tooltip.wizardSecondary: Choose a folder that already has a Serato library.
tooltip.wizardUpdatesNo: Don't check GitHub for new versions.
tooltip.wizardUpdatesYes: Check GitHub once a day for a new version.
tooltip.wizardYes: Share anonymous stats and crash reports.
tooltip.zoomIn: Show a shorter stretch of the waveform around the playhead.
tooltip.zoomOut: Show a longer stretch of the waveform around the playhead.
update.availableTest: Test version {version} is out. You have {current}.
update.label: Update available

view.label: Views

wizard.heading.consent: Share anonymous usage stats and crash reports?
wizard.noSubfolders: This folder has no folders inside it.
wizard.savingLibraryCopy: Saving a safety copy of your library.
wizard.snapshotBody: A backup of your library data is saved before anything is changed.
wizard.snapshotFailed: The safety copy could not be saved. Your library was not changed. Try again.

wizard.updatesFailed: The choice could not be saved. Try again.
wizard.welcomeBody: This app shows the library Serato already keeps on this computer. It will not change anything without asking.
tooltip.cratePromptConfirm: Save this crate name. Serato DJ Pro must be quit.
tooltip.cratePromptName: Type the crate name, or a color name.
tooltip.crateNotConnected: This crate's drive is not connected. The tracks are not missing.
tooltip.overwriteSameName: When this is off, a crate file that already has this name on a drive is left as it is.
tooltip.stickConfirm: Save a copy of this stick's crates, then write, even when the stick belongs to another library.
tooltip.stickReview: List cues that are on the stick and not in the library. Nothing is written.
tooltip.stickImport: Copy those cues into empty pads only. A cue you already have stays.
tooltip.relocatePath: Type the path to the audio file.
tooltip.relocateCancel: Close without changing the file location.
tooltip.relocateConfirm: Save this file location. Serato DJ Pro must be quit.
tooltip.forceWrite: Write even though the library files changed after they were loaded.
write.forceConfirm: The library files changed on disk since they were loaded. Write anyway?
markers.cueEdit.help: Edit hot cues 1–8 here. Apply writes the audio file after a snapshot. Quit Serato first. Saved loops and the beatgrid stay view-only.
markers.cueEdit.name: Cue name
markers.cueEdit.swapPick: Choose another pad to swap with pad {number}.
markers.cueEdit.savedUndo: Cue points saved. Undo puts the previous tags back.
tooltip.cueEditApply: Write the pending hot cues into the audio file. Quit Serato first.
tooltip.cueEditDiscard: Throw away pending cue edits and keep the file as it is.
tooltip.cueEditUndo: Put the previous cue tags back from the pre-write snapshot.
tooltip.cueEditDisabled: Cue editing is unavailable for this file.
tooltip.cueEditTime: Type a cue time as m:ss.sss.
tooltip.cueEditColor: Pick a Serato pad color for this cue.
tooltip.cueEditDelete: Clear this pad. Apply writes the change.
tooltip.cueEditSet: Set this empty pad at the playhead.
tooltip.cueEditSwap: Swap this pad with another. Click Swap, then the other pad.
tooltip.cueEditBeatBack: Move this cue one beat earlier.
tooltip.cueEditBeatForward: Move this cue one beat later.
error.cue_edit_needs_confirm: Confirm before cue points are saved.
error.cue_edit_needs_undo: Confirm before cue points are put back.
error.cue_edit_protected: Cue points are protected in Settings.
error.cue_edit_unsupported: This file format cannot take cue edits yet.
error.cue_edit_missing: The file is not on disk, so cues cannot be edited.
error.cue_edit_corrupt: That cue list cannot be updated.
error.cue_edit_outside_change: The audio file changed since you started editing.
error.cue_edit_bad_pads: That cue list is not valid.
error.gain_cannot_rewrite: Stored gain could not be rewritten, so nothing was kept.
error.gain_did_not_stick: The gain did not read back as 0 dB, so the files were put back.
error.gain_frames_moved: Other Serato tags would have changed, so the files were put back.
error.gain_needs_confirm: Confirm before stored gain is reset to 0 dB.
error.streams_mismatch: That repair does not match the current list.
gain.empty: No track has a stored gain other than 0 dB.
gain.heading: Gain changed
gain.intro: Lists tracks whose stored gain is not 0 dB. Saving a crate writes the library. Reset to 0 dB writes that gain in the audio file and leaves cues, the beatgrid, overview, and analysis alone. Quit Serato first.
gain.loadFailed: The gain report could not be read.
gain.note: Only the stored gain changes. Auto gain, cues, the beatgrid, overview, and analysis stay.

gain.offline.one: An unplugged drive is not a gain change. {count} file is on an unplugged drive.
gain.offline.other: An unplugged drive is not a gain change. {count} files are on unplugged drives.

gain.previewCrate.one: Save {count} track in {name}, inside {folder}. Nothing is written until you confirm.
gain.previewCrate.other: Save {count} tracks in {name}, inside {folder}. Nothing is written until you confirm.

gain.previewEmpty: Nothing to change. No crate is written and no gain is reset.

gain.previewReset.one: Reset stored gain to 0 dB on {count} track. Quit Serato first. Nothing is written until you confirm.
gain.previewReset.other: Reset stored gain to 0 dB on {count} tracks. Quit Serato first. Nothing is written until you confirm.

gain.resetDone.one: Reset stored gain to 0 dB on {count} track. Undo puts that file back.
gain.resetDone.other: Reset stored gain to 0 dB on {count} tracks. Undo puts those files back.

gain.summary.one: {checked} files checked. {count} track has a stored gain other than 0 dB.
gain.summary.other: {checked} files checked. {count} tracks have a stored gain other than 0 dB.

gain.summaryClear: {checked} files checked. None have a stored gain other than 0 dB.
gain.undone: The reset was undone. Stored gain is back.

gain.unreadable.one: {count} file has stored gain this app cannot read, so it was left as it was.
gain.unreadable.other: {count} files have stored gain this app cannot read, so they were left as they were.

mode.gain: Lists tracks whose stored gain is not 0 dB. Reset writes that gain only. Cues, the beatgrid, overview, and analysis stay. Quit Serato first.
mode.streams: Points a greyed-out Beatport or Beatsource track at a local file. Colour and crate order stay on that row. Quit Serato first.
tooltip.gainConfirmCrate: Save the Gain changed crate inside the crateCraft folder. Quit Serato first. The audio file stays.
tooltip.gainConfirmReset: Set stored gain to 0 dB. Quit Serato first. Cues, the beatgrid, overview, and analysis stay. Undo puts the files back.
tooltip.gainRefresh: Check again for tracks whose stored gain is not 0 dB. Nothing is written.
tooltip.gainReset: Show the reset plan. Nothing is written until you confirm.
tooltip.gainSave: Show the crate plan. Nothing is written until you confirm.
tooltip.gainUndo: Put the last gain reset back from its snapshot. Quit Serato first.
tooltip.viewGain: List tracks whose stored gain is not 0 dB. Reset writes that gain only, after you confirm. Quit Serato first.
tooltip.viewStreams: Replace a greyed-out Beatport or Beatsource track with one local file. Colour and crate order stay. Quit Serato first.
tooltip.streamsRefresh: Check again for greyed-out Beatport and Beatsource tracks. Nothing is written.
tooltip.streamsRepair: Show the repair plan for each unique local match. Nothing is written until you confirm.
tooltip.streamsConfirm: Point those rows at the local files. Colour, crate order, and cue points in the file stay. Quit Serato first.
streams.heading: Streaming repair
streams.intro: Greyed-out Beatport and Beatsource tracks can be pointed at a local file with the same artist and title. The library row stays, so its colour and its place in each crate stay. Cue points already in the file are left as they are. Quit Serato first.

streams.preview.one: Nothing is written until you confirm. {count} track keeps its colour and its crate order.
streams.preview.other: Nothing is written until you confirm. {count} tracks keep their colour and their crate order.

streams.summary.one: {checked} greyed-out streaming tracks. {count} has one local match.
streams.summary.other: {checked} greyed-out streaming tracks. {count} have one local match.

streams.summaryClear: {checked} greyed-out streaming tracks. None has one local match.
streams.empty: No greyed-out Beatport or Beatsource tracks.
streams.truncated: The file search stopped early. Some matches may be missing.
streams.cuesKept: Cue points stored on the library row stay with it. Cue points already in the local file are left as they are.

streams.written.one: Pointed {count} track at its local file. Colour and crate order stayed.
streams.written.other: Pointed {count} tracks at their local files. Colour and crate order stayed.

streams.loadFailed: The streaming repair list could not be read.
streams.unreachable: Couldn't reach the library server. Check it's running, then press Check again
mode.reanalyze: Needs a crate. Marks tracks unanalyzed so Serato rebuilds grids. Cues stay. Quit Serato first.
reanalyze.heading: Re-analyze
reanalyze.intro: Needs a crate. Marks tracks unanalyzed so Serato rebuilds grids and overviews. Cues stay. Quit Serato first.
reanalyze.confirmHint: Quit Serato first. Then open the tracks in Serato to rebuild.
reanalyze.loadFailed: The re-analyze plan could not be read.
reanalyze.unreachable: Couldn't reach the library server. Check it's running, then press Check again

reanalyze.summary.one: 1 track ready for Serato to re-analyze.
reanalyze.summary.other: {count} tracks ready for Serato to re-analyze.

reanalyze.summaryClear: No tracks need a re-analyze mark.
reanalyze.empty: Nothing to mark. Pick a crate that still has analysis.
reanalyze.markersNote: Markers2 cues stay. BeatGrid and Autotags clear when that option is on. Open the tracks in Serato to rebuild.

reanalyze.lockedNote.one: 1 track has a locked beatgrid and was skipped.
reanalyze.lockedNote.other: {count} tracks have locked beatgrids and were skipped.

reanalyze.previewReady.one: Preview ready: 1 track. Confirm to mark it.
reanalyze.previewReady.other: Preview ready: {count} tracks. Confirm to mark them.

reanalyze.previewEmpty: Nothing to mark. No write will run.
reanalyze.optionsChanged: Preview again before Confirm. The options changed.
reanalyze.driveAbsent: A track's drive is not connected. Serato may put the analyzed mark back when that drive returns.

reanalyze.written.one: Marked 1 track. Open it in Serato to rebuild.
reanalyze.written.other: Marked {count} tracks. Open them in Serato to rebuild.

tooltip.viewReanalyze: Mark tracks unanalyzed so Serato rebuilds grids and overviews. Needs a crate. Cues stay. Quit Serato first.
tooltip.reanalyzeRefresh: Check again which tracks still need a re-analyze mark.
tooltip.reanalyzePreview: Preview the mark without writing. Quit Serato before Confirm.
tooltip.reanalyzeConfirm: Mark the listed tracks unanalyzed. Takes a snapshot first. Quit Serato first.
tooltip.reanalyzeClearFrames: Remove BeatGrid and Autotags from the files. Markers2 cues stay. Off marks the database only.
tooltip.reanalyzeIncludeLocked: Also unlock locked beatgrids so Serato can rebuild them.
error.reanalyze_needs_confirm: Confirm before tracks are marked for re-analyze.
error.reanalyze_did_not_stick: The unanalyzed mark did not stick. The library was put back.
error.reanalyze_locked: Those beatgrids are locked. Turn on Include locked beatgrids to unlock them.

error.history_rescue_source: That history source is not available.

error.stick_backup_dest_serato: A stick backup cannot go into the Serato folder.

historyRescue.sessionsEmpty: Compare a source to list sessions.
historyRescue.skippedLive: Skipped {count} sessions already in live history.
historyRescue.status: {only_source} only in source, {only_live} only live, {disagree} disagree.

tooltip.historyRescueCompare: Show a per-session diff. Nothing is written.
tooltip.historyRescueCrates: Create dated crates for the chosen sessions. Serato must be quit.

tooltip.historyRescueScan: List backups, snapshots, and any unchecked History folder.

tooltip.stickBackupDest: Folder on another drive or a mounted disk image. The stick is never written.
